Crab Team N Robot 1’s First Room

One ESP32-CAM, 49 seconds, one straight drive. COLMAP solved 70 camera poses from 125 QVGA frames; monocular depth anchored to those poses fills in the surfaces. The wheel trace is drawn beside the solved trace, because agreeing twice is the only evidence here.

  • assumedEvery metre here scales with one guess. Motor targets, not encoders: dead reckoning assumes k = 0.50 m/s at full target and a 0.12 m track. Neither was measured. SfM inherits that scale through the fit, so both traces stretch together if the guess is wrong. The 5.2 cm agreement is about shape, not size.
  • not identifiableFocal length cannot be solved from this footage. A fixed-focal sweep registers 70 of 70 at every value from 120 to 550 px. This cloud was built at COLMAP’s free-bundle focal, 142.4 px, which falls outside the admissible 160–300 px bracket. Calibrate the camera; nothing in this dataset substitutes.
  • inferredThe dense surfaces are predicted, not triangulated. COLMAP dense stereo needs CUDA and refuses to run here, so this is Depth Anything V2 depth fitted per frame to the sparse points. 57 of 70 depth maps passed the fit, 13 were rejected. Two views of one wall still disagree by 10.7–16% in depth, and the fit caps depth near 1.3 m, so the far half of the room is simply absent.
  • dropped69 usable poses, not 70. One registered camera, frame 20, solved to |C| = 1.8e14 model units against a median of 2.8. It is marked amber on the frame strip and excluded everywhere else on this page.
